# PM002 milestone-epics-incomplete

A milestone has no epics, or a member epic is done while work under it is open.

## What it does

A milestone's work arrives through its member epics (`milestone add EPIC
VERSION`). With none it plans nothing; and an epic that is already `done`
while a descendant ticket is still open claims a completeness it does not
have. Without milestone objects the rule is not applicable.

## Why it matters

A milestone with no epics plans nothing, and a done epic with open work claims a completeness it lacks.

## Remedy

Add an epic with `frob milestone add EPIC VERSION`, or reopen the epic (or
finish or move the open tickets under it).

## Examples

### A violating case fires

```rust expect=fire file=src/lib.rs
pub fn placeholder() {}
```

### A conforming case is clean

```rust expect=clean file=src/lib.rs
pub fn placeholder() {}
```

## Examples

### PM002 milestone epic completeness / A milestone with no epics fires #1 (line 8) (fire)

```text
milestone 0.532.0 epics=
```

### PM002 milestone epic completeness / A member epic that is done while a child is open fires #2 (line 14) (fire)

```text
epic in state=done
task leaf parent=in
milestone 0.532.0 epics=in
```

### PM002 milestone epic completeness / A member epic that is done while a deep descendant is open fires #3 (line 22) (fire)

```text
epic in state=done
epic sub parent=in
task leaf parent=sub
milestone 0.532.0 epics=in
```

### PM002 milestone epic completeness / A member epic that is done with all work done is clean #4 (line 31) (clean)

```text
epic in state=done
task leaf parent=in state=done
milestone 0.532.0 epics=in
```

### PM002 milestone epic completeness / An open member epic with open work is clean #5 (line 39) (clean)

```text
epic in
task leaf parent=in
milestone 0.532.0 epics=in
```

### PM002 milestone epic completeness / An open task outside the member epic is clean #6 (line 47) (clean)

```text
epic in state=done
task other
milestone 0.532.0 epics=in
```

### PM002 milestone epic completeness / A repository without milestones is not applicable and stays clean #7 (line 55) (clean)

```text
epic a
```
